scope: Source review and isolated QA simulations; not a real provider/media acceptance pass
productionChange: Only awaiting_disclosure actions remain actionable in the existing MCP settings page; authorized is treated as processed
providerDisclosureAuthority: Original desktop public pending-action status matched to the client, project, canvas and Agnes provider; only authorized permits continuation
providerDisclosureNavigation: Existing /settings/mcp page, human decision, original canvas restored and canvasReady verified before a new natural-language configuration turn
connectionDetectionGate: Requires Main response associated with test_provider_connection to explicitly report unsupported for Agnes; no generation-based authentication probe
mediaContinuationPolicy: Only read existing scoped confirmation actions and TaskStore tasks; query-only natural-language turns expose read-only enabled_tools and read persisted results. Creation prompts are not replayed; only submitted counts as a confirmed proposal
